parameters.name: acceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese.
- en-US: English.

Default value: zh-CN.

parameters.name: filterReadOnly
parameters.description: Specifies whether to filter read-only properties.

parameters.name: resourceType
parameters.description: The resource code used to retrieve detailed information about a specified resource type.

parameters.name: terraformProviderVersion
parameters.description: The Terraform provider version. If this parameter is left empty, the latest version is used by default.
